hints.title: Group Count Divisibility
hints.text: The total number of elements must be an exact multiple of the group size k.

hints.title: Pigeonhole Frequency Bound
hints.text: Because each group contains at most one instance of any value, no value can appear more times than the number of groups.

hints.title: Sufficiency Check
hints.text: If every frequency is bounded by n // k, elements can always be distributed validly across groups.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def canPartition(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> bool:
        n = len(nums)
        if n % k != 0:
            return False
            
        num_groups = n // k
        counts = Counter(nums)
        
        # In any group of size k, all elements must be distinct
        # Thus, no element can appear more times than the number of groups
        for val, freq in counts.items():
            if freq > num_groups:
                return False
                
        return True
```
